item.text: [{"task_id":"b457fec5","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    gray = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    neighbors = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    palette = [int(grid[r, c]) for r, c in np.argwhere((grid != bg) & (grid != gray))]","    out = grid.copy()","    if not palette:","        return out","    remaining = set((int(r), int(c)) for r, c in np.argwhere(grid == gray))","    while remaining:","        start = next(iter(remaining))","        remaining.remove(start)","        component = [start]","        queue = [start]","        while queue:","            r, c = queue.pop()","            for dr, dc in neighbors:","                point = (r + dr, c + dc)","                if point in remaining:","                    remaining.remove(point)","                    component.append(point)","                    queue.append(point)","        top = min(r for r, c in component)","        bottom = max(r for r, c in component)","        first = [c for r, c in component if r == top]","        last = [c for r, c in component if r == bottom]","        left = min(c for r, c in component)","        right = max(c for r, c in component)","        cap = bottom - top + int(round(params['unit'][0])) - len(first)","        positive = min(last) > min(first)","        for r, c in component:","            horizontal = c - left if positive else right - c","            index = min(r - top, horizontal, cap)","            out[r, c] = palette[index % len(palette)]","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"neighbors":[4,2],"unit":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,5],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]],"unit":[1]},"rationale":"Read the ordered palette from the colored header. Each gray component is a diagonal ribbon of nested L-shaped bands. Assign palette colors cyclically by the minimum distance from its top and its vertical starting edge, capped at the final band before the ribbon tapers."}]
